releases.recording_review: DG identifies Michelangeli, Giulini and Wiener Symphoniker in a live televised Vienna concert, consistent with cached LP sleeve notes naming Vienna 1 February 1979. The saved digital edition is marked Live and carries all three Op.73 movements with those credits; this supports the recording family, not exact takes or mastering.
limitations: Publisher page describes a 1987 CD reissue (UPC00028941924926); saved Qobuz edition has a different UPC0028948377497.
The publisher page does not independently confirm the exact date of the saved digital tracks.
Exact LP pressing, takes and digital mastering are not independently verified.
